an7.61:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā bhaggesu viharati suṃsumāragire bhesakalāvane migadāye.
an7.61:1.3: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā mahāmoggallāno magadhesu kallavālamuttagāme capalāyamāno nisinno hoti.
an7.61:1.4: addasā kho bhagavā dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena āyasmantaṃ mahāmoggallānaṃ magadhesu kallavālamuttagāme capalāyamānaṃ nisinnaṃ
an7.61:1.6: seyyathāpi nāma balavā puriso sammiñjitaṃ vā bāhaṃ pasāreyya pasāritaṃ vā bāhaṃ sammiñjeyya evameva bhaggesu suṃsumāragire bhesakalāvane migadāye antarahito magadhesu kallavālamuttagāme āyasmato mahāmoggallānassa pamukhe pāturahosi
an7.61:1.8: nisajja kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ mahāmoggallānaṃ etadavoca
an7.61:2.1: capalāyasi no tvaṃ moggallāna capalāyasi no tvaṃ moggallānāti.
an7.61:2.3: tasmā tiha moggallāna yathāsaññissa te viharato taṃ middhaṃ okkamati taṃ saññaṃ manasikareyyāsi taṃ saññaṃ bahulaṃ kareyyāsi
an7.61:2.4: ṭhānaṃ kho panetaṃ vijjati yante evaṃ viharato taṃ middhaṃ pahīyetha
an7.61:3.1: no ce te evaṃ viharato taṃ middhaṃ pahīyetha tato tvaṃ moggallāna yathāsutaṃ yathāpariyattaṃ dhammaṃ cetasā anuvitakkeyyāsi anuvicāreyyāsi manasānupekkheyyāsi
an7.61:3.2: ṭhānaṃ kho panetaṃ vijjati yante evaṃ viharato taṃ middhaṃ pahīyetha
an7.61:4.1: no ce te evaṃ viharato taṃ middhaṃ pahīyetha tato tvaṃ moggallāna yathāsutaṃ yathāpariyattaṃ dhammaṃ vitthārena sajjhāyaṃ kareyyāsi
an7.61:4.2: ṭhānaṃ kho panetaṃ vijjati yante evaṃ viharato taṃ middhaṃ pahīyetha
an7.61:5.1: no ce te evaṃ viharato taṃ middhaṃ pahīyetha tato tvaṃ moggallāna ubho kaṇṇasotāni āvijeyyāsi pāṇinā gattāni anumajjeyyāsi
an7.61:5.2: ṭhānaṃ kho panetaṃ vijjati yante evaṃ viharato taṃ middhaṃ pahīyetha
an7.61:6.1: no ce te evaṃ viharato taṃ middhaṃ pahīyetha tato tvaṃ moggallāna uṭṭhāyāsanā udakena akkhīni anumajjitvā disā anuvilokeyyāsi nakkhattāni tārakarūpāni ullokeyyāsi
an7.61:6.2: ṭhānaṃ kho panetaṃ vijjati yante evaṃ viharato taṃ middhaṃ pahīyetha
an7.61:7.1: no ce te evaṃ viharato taṃ middhaṃ pahīyetha tato tvaṃ moggallāna ālokasaññaṃ manasikareyyāsi divāsaññaṃ adhiṭṭhaheyyāsi
an7.61:7.2: yathā divā tathā rattiṃ yathā rattiṃ tathā divā
an7.61:7.3: iti vivaṭṭena cetasā apariyonaddhena sappabhāsaṃ cittaṃ bhāveyyāsi
an7.61:7.4: ṭhānaṃ kho panetaṃ vijjati yante evaṃ viharato taṃ middhaṃ pahīyetha
an7.61:8.1: no ce te evaṃ viharato taṃ middhaṃ pahīyetha tato tvaṃ moggallāna pacchāpuresaññī caṅkamaṃ adhiṭṭhaheyyāsi antogatehi indriyehi abahigatena mānasena
an7.61:8.2: ṭhānaṃ kho panetaṃ vijjati yante evaṃ viharato taṃ middhaṃ pahīyetha
an7.61:9.1: no ce te evaṃ viharato taṃ middhaṃ pahīyetha tato tvaṃ moggallāna dakkhiṇena passena sīhaseyyaṃ kappeyyāsi pādena pādaṃ accādhāya sato sampajāno uṭṭhānasaññaṃ manasikaritvā
an7.61:9.3: na seyyasukhaṃ na passasukhaṃ na middhasukhaṃ anuyutto viharissāmīti
an7.61:10.4: sace moggallāna bhikkhu uccāsoṇḍaṃ paggahetvā kulāni upasaṅkamati santi hi moggallāna kulesu kiccakaraṇīyāni
an7.61:10.5: yena manussā āgataṃ bhikkhuṃ na manasikaronti tatra bhikkhussa evaṃ hoti
an7.61:10.6: ko su nāma dāni maṃ imasmiṃ kule paribhindi virattarūpādānīme mayi manussāti
an7.61:10.7: itissa alābhena maṅkubhāvo maṅkubhūtassa uddhaccaṃ uddhatassa asaṃvaro asaṃvutassa ārā cittaṃ samādhimhā
an7.61:11.4: viggāhikāya moggallāna kathāya sati kathābāhullaṃ pāṭikaṅkhaṃ kathābāhulle sati uddhaccaṃ uddhatassa asaṃvaro asaṃvutassa ārā cittaṃ samādhimhā
an7.61:11.6: na panāhaṃ moggallāna sabbeheva saṃsaggaṃ na vaṇṇayāmi
an7.61:11.7: sagahaṭṭhapabbajitehi kho ahaṃ moggallāna saṃsaggaṃ na vaṇṇayāmi
an7.61:11.8: yāni ca kho tāni senāsanāni appasaddāni appanigghosāni vijanavātāni manussarāhaseyyakāni paṭisallānasāruppāni tathārūpehi senāsanehi saṃsaggaṃ vaṇṇayāmīti.
an7.61:12.1: evaṃ vutte āyasmā mahāmoggallāno bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
an7.61:12.2: kittāvatā nu kho bhante bhikkhu saṅkhittena taṇhāsaṅkhayavimutto hoti accantaniṭṭho accantayogakkhemī accantabrahmacārī accantapariyosāno seṭṭho devamanussānanti.
an7.61:13.5: so sabbaṃ dhammaṃ abhijānāti sabbaṃ dhammaṃ abhiññāya sabbaṃ dhammaṃ parijānāti sabbaṃ dhammaṃ pariññāya yaṃkiñci vedanaṃ vediyati sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā
an7.61:13.6: so tāsu vedanāsu aniccānupassī viharati virāgānupassī viharati nirodhānupassī viharati paṭinissaggānupassī viharati
an7.61:13.7: so tāsu vedanāsu aniccānupassī viharanto virāgānupassī viharanto nirodhānupassī viharanto paṭinissaggānupassī viharanto na ca kiñci loke upādiyati
an7.61:13.8: anupādiyaṃ na paritassati aparitassaṃ paccattaññeva parinibbāyati
an7.61:13.9: khīṇā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānāti
an7.61:13.10: ettāvatā kho moggallāna bhikkhu saṅkhittena taṇhāsaṅkhayavimutto hoti accantaniṭṭho accantayogakkhemī accantabrahmacārī accantapariyosāno seṭṭho devamanussānanti.
